title: code_index.cypher request
description: Run a read-only Cypher query against the workspace typed symbol graph. Supported subset: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN with typed nodes (Function|Type|Field|EnumCase|Module|Import|CallSite|Macro), typed edges (CALLS|REFS|IMPORTS|CONTAINS|OVERRIDES with `_BY` inverses), variable-length hops up to depth 4 (`*1..N`), and AND/OR/NOT predicates. The query observes the per-branch overlay if one is active (see `branch_overlay`). Execution is bounded: the executor materializes at most 10,000 rows (intermediate bindings and projected rows alike) and accepts at most 3 comma-separated MATCH patterns — exceeding either budget surfaces a parse or exec error instead of running unboundedly.
